target.title: fix(telegram): dedupe directive-tag prompt context
target.body:
﻿## Summary

Fixes #99117.

Telegram direct-message prompt context can include the same assistant reply twice: once from the session transcript with a synthetic `session:*` id and inline directive tag such as `[[reply_to_current]]`, and once from the Telegram cache with the delivered text. The original reporter confirmed the real OpenClaw 2026.6.11 path can also have a send-time timestamp gap between the two rows, for example `session:bc268f12` at 12:03:12 PDT and Telegram message `808` at 12:03:18 PDT.

This PR moves the Telegram session/cache dedupe and merge logic into a small Telegram-owned module. It normalizes text with the existing public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-chunking` delivery stripping helper, keeps exact timestamp/body dedupe for aligned rows, and adds a narrow near-time fallback only for synthetic OpenClaw session rows whose text actually changed after stripping directive tags. Plain repeated text with different timestamps still stays as separate context.

## Verification

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
- Red check: `pnpm exec tsx -e "import('./extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.js').catch((err)=>{ console.error(err.message); process.exit(1); })"` failed before implementation with missing module.
- Red check for merge helper: `pnpm exec tsx -e "import('./extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.ts').then((m)=>{ if(typeof m.mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages !== 'function') throw new Error('merge helper missing'); })"` failed before the merge helper existed.
- Red check for the reporter drift case: `pnpm exec tsx -e "import { mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages } from './extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.ts'; const result = mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages({ sessionPromptMessages: [{message_id:'session:bc268f12', sender:'OpenClaw', timestamp_ms:1783019792000, body:'[[reply_to_current]]Duplicate context test reply - issue 99117'}], cachePromptMessages: [{message_id:'808', sender:'OpenClaw', timestamp_ms:1783019798000, body:'Duplicate context test reply - issue 99117'}] }); if (result.sessionOnlyPromptMessages.length !== 0 || result.promptMessages.map((m)=>m.message_id).join(',') !== '808') { throw new Error('directive timestamp drift duplicate survived'); }"` failed before the drift fallback.
- `pnpm exec tsx -e "import { mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages, resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey } from './extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.ts'; const a=resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey({timestamp_ms:1778474760000,body:'[[reply_to_current]]Yep'}); const b=resolvePromptContextTextDedupeKey({timestamp_ms:1778474760000,body:'Yep'}); if(a!==b) throw new Error('same timestamp directive key mismatch'); const drift=mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages({sessionPromptMessages:[{message_id:'session:bc268f12',sender:'OpenClaw',timestamp_ms:1783019792000,body:'[[reply_to_current]]Duplicate context test reply - issue 99117'}],cachePromptMessages:[{message_id:'808',sender:'OpenClaw',timestamp_ms:1783019798000,body:'Duplicate context test reply - issue 99117'}]}); if(drift.sessionOnlyPromptMessages.length!==0 || drift.promptMessages.length!==1 || drift.promptMessages[0]?.message_id!=='808') throw new Error('directive timestamp drift not deduped'); const plain=mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages({sessionPromptMessages:[{message_id:'session:plain',sender:'OpenClaw',timestamp_ms:1783019792000,body:'Duplicate context test reply - issue 99117'}],cachePromptMessages:[{message_id:'808',sender:'OpenClaw',timestamp_ms:1783019798000,body:'Duplicate context test reply - issue 99117'}]}); if(plain.sessionOnlyPromptMessages.length!==1 || plain.promptMessages.length!==2) throw new Error('plain timestamp drift collapsed'); const missingSender=mergeTelegramPromptContextMessages({sessionPromptMessages:[{message_id:'session:no-sender',timestamp_ms:1783019792000,body:'[[reply_to_current]]Duplicate context test reply - issue 99117'}],cachePromptMessages:[{message_id:'808',sender:'OpenClaw',timestamp_ms:1783019798000,body:'Duplicate context test reply - issue 99117'}]}); if(missingSender.sessionOnlyPromptMessages.length!==1) throw new Error('missing sender row used drift fallback'); console.log('prompt-context drift/directive assertions passed');"`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check extensions/telegram/src/bot-handlers.runtime.ts extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.ts extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.test.ts`
- `node scripts/check-extension-plugin-sdk-boundary.mjs --mode=src-outside-plugin-sdk`
- `git diff --check`

Known local proof gaps:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/telegram/src/prompt-context-dedupe.test.ts` did not reach test output in this Windows worktree after 60 seconds and was stopped by exact Node PID. This matches the earlier local Vitest-wrapper hang in this worktree.
- `pnpm exec tsgo -p extensions/telegram/tsconfig.json --noEmit` is not a valid local narrow check in this worktree as-is; it fails on many existing `openclaw/plugin-sdk/*` type-resolution errors unrelated to this diff.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` previously failed before review with Windows `NotADirectoryError: [WinError 267]` while spawning `git`, including through a temporary `subst` ASCII drive.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: Telegram DM prompt context no longer keeps both the synthetic session transcript assistant row and the Telegram cache assistant row when the session row contains an inline directive tag and the delivered cache row has the same delivered text, including the real reporter's timestamp-drift shape.

Real environment tested: Local Windows source worktree with focused helper/runtime import proof, plus PR `Real behavior proof` checks. The original reporter also posted a real OpenClaw 2026.6.11 Telegram DM capture showing the pre-fix duplicate shape on macOS 26.3.1 arm64 with `openai/gpt-5.4`.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: See `Verification` above.

Evidence after fix: The focused helper assertion showed `[[reply_to_current]]Yep` and `Yep` produce the same exact-timestamp key; the reporter-shaped merge assertion showed `session:bc268f12` at `1783019792000` is filtered when Telegram cache message `808` at `1783019798000` has the same delivered text; the plain drift assertion showed the same text without stripped directive tags still keeps both rows; the missing-sender assertion showed the near-time fallback remains scoped to synthetic OpenClaw session rows.

Observed result after fix: `prompt-context drift/directive assertions passed`; formatting, extension plugin-SDK boundary, and whitespace checks passed.

What was not tested: No completed live Telegram DM artifact from this branch is attached yet. The PR still needs Mantis or equivalent redacted Telegram proof to clear the scoped Telegram reply-context proof bar.
